Adaptation Hombrew of Arianrhod 2E Legacy Classes

Legacy Classes are special classes that need a General Skill to be accessible, but not directly, you only learn the skills from your Legacy Class, instead of taking the class like normaly. This General Skill cannot be learn normally and is a Quest Reward of the GM and don't count toward the limits. 
Theses Legacy Classes offers two important thing: A Legacy Action, that can be use before either your Move, Minor or Major Action (but not after the Major Action) in your Main Process. And a "Unique Mechanic", a gimmick only for the class and differents for the four of them.
The Legacy Sign General Skill and the four variant you can learn.

A class that have access to numerous Arcanum Card to control destiny and tip the balance in your favor. - The Arcanum are lore from another world, different from Earth or the Konosuba's, treat them as such... or not.

Gain CL+2 "Type: Arcanum" Items (Arcanum Card) and add them to your Deck. During Preplay, you can remade your Deck from scratch. (The Deck is treated like a separate inventory only for Arcanum Cards. You can only have up to 2 duplicate Arcanum Card in your Deck and can use the Effect of any card when the timing is specified. Each Arcanum Card is usable Once per Scenario, but are not lost.)

The blessings of the Arcanum go with you.
(I don't have all the details on how the Fortunate's Deck work, so I did with what I could interpret for the explaination.)
During Preplay, gain an additional SL Arcanum Cards and add them to your Deck.
You may access and utilise a larger number of Arcanum.
The maximum number of duplicate of each Arcanum Card in your Deck becomes 3. (Normally 2)
Your Deck contains more copies of some Arcana than usual.
Effective while you are under the effects of a Arcanum Card. Your Attacks get +2 to Hit Checks.
Use the effects of the Arcanum to your advantage, boosting the effectiveness of your attacks.
All Arcanum Cards in your Deck that have been used at least once this Scenario gain 1 additional instance of use.
Shuffle your Deck, letting you re-use Arcana which you have already expended.
As a Minor Action, you may use a Arcanum Card that normally requires a Legacy Action. However, you may not use the same Card twice during this Main Process.
Quickly draw and activate a card from your Deck.
Effective while you are under the effects of a Arcanum Card. Your Attacks get +1d6 Damage.
Use the effects of the Arcanum to your advantage, significantly enhancing your abilities.
Only usable out of combat. Choose 1 Arcanum Card in your Deck and 1 Arcanum Card that is not being used in your Deck. Swap the two Items. This effect lasts until the end of the Scenario.
Swap out an Arcanum in your Deck for another you are holding in reserve.
Usable whenever you use a Arcanum Card. Use that Item's "Reverse" instead of its "Effect". The timing become the Reverse's timing.
By reversing the Arcanum as you draw it, its power manifests in a different form.
